EmailTemplate.subject: Need payments help? Speak to an expert today!

Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}},
Payment security is a big deal for travelers – 69% of luxury travelers told us in a survey earlier this year it was a concern. They also expect payment experiences that allow them to pay in their local currencies, online. Delivering on all of that isn’t always easy for travel businesses.
Flywire <[[https://www.flywire.com/industries/travel]]> is empowering 400+ travel businesses including Madrid & Beyond, Northern Escape Heli Skiing, and Livensa Living to solve their complex payment problems and meet the needs of luxury travelers. This gives them the ability to save thousands on fees, improve payer experiences, and prioritize privacy and security.
Do you have a few minutes next week for a quick chat? I would love to see if Flywire might be of use to your company! You can schedule time with one of our payment experts here <[[https://meet.yesware.com/me/stefano-fontana/30min]]>.
All the best,
Sydney Banks Manager, Flywire
